annotations.title: Verified Base DEX pair details and market data

description: Base DEX pair lookup through DexScreener: verified pair identity, tokens, reported liquidity, volume, trades and pair age where available. Returns source and retrieval time; missing fields are null. No pool-security or investment-risk assessment. Missing pairs return 404; upstream failure returns 502. Example values are illustrative. Use to check a pair's liquidity before trading. Example: address=0x98c7A2338336d2d354663246F64676009c7bDa97. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
